title: spec(automation): IAutomationService.toggleFlow has no caller channel, so a flow switch-off cannot record which admin did it (the spec half of #26474)
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a live reproduction, the spec half of #26474. Filed by the `domain:server` seat 1 under `cross-repo-coordination.md` rule 3, because the server lane holds no `packages/spec` (`lanes/server.md` red line). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: when an admin switches off a packaged flow, the `sys_metadata_activation` row and its `sys_audit_log` row carry a null actor, so the audit trail cannot say which administrator disabled a shipped flow (#26474, reproduced live on a stock showcase boot at `756220c4`).
Reader: the `domain:spec` lane, `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts:997`. The server half rides #26474, which waits on this card for its flow door.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "toggleFlow caller context actor IAutomationService" → only #26474.

## What to declare

`IAutomationService.toggleFlow?(name: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void>` (`automation-service.ts:997`) has no caller channel. The runtime reaches the activation-ledger write for a flow only through this method, and it holds the service as `Partial<IAutomationService>`, so a third argument cannot be passed without the contract. Measured by the #26474 card thread (os-dev-report `6434804607`): service-automation's own `toggleFlow` header (engine.ts about :5289) records the same gap.

- Declare an optional caller channel on `toggleFlow`, so the door can hand down who made the request. The shape is the spec seat's to choose. The precedent in the same contract is `execute(flowName: string, context?: AutomationContext)` at `:905`.
- Optional, so every current implementer and caller compiles unchanged.

The decision record behind this card: seat ruling on #26474 (letter A of its `needs_decision` report). B (an ambient AsyncLocalStorage scope) and C (an undeclared duck-typed parameter) were set aside: both leave a missed caller writing a silent null.

## Out of scope
- The server half: the toggle doors pass the caller, and the core activation store writes with it. That is #26474.
- The action and security activation doors, which need no spec change and land first under #26474.
